purpose: Evidence excerpt for the Alphabet Business Map review spike; not a replacement for the immutable source document.

translation.notice_zh: 中文为忠实翻译候选，尚待人工复核；投资判断与正式引用以 SEC 英文原文为准。

paragraphs.text: Alphabet is a collection of businesses — the largest of which is Google. We report Google in two segments, Google Services and Google Cloud, and all non-Google businesses collectively as Other Bets. Supporting these businesses, we have centralized certain AI-related research and development focused on advanced research in AI and developing the frontier models that serve our businesses, which is reported in Alphabet-level activities. Alphabet's structure is about helping each of our businesses prosper through strong leaders and independence.
paragraphs.translation_zh: Alphabet 由多项业务组成，其中规模最大的是 Google。我们将 Google 分为 Google Services 和 Google Cloud 两个分部进行报告，并将所有非 Google 业务统一报告为 Other Bets。为支持这些业务，我们集中开展部分 AI 相关研发，重点包括 AI 前沿研究以及开发服务于各项业务的前沿模型，并将其计入 Alphabet 层面的活动。Alphabet 的组织结构旨在通过强有力的领导和独立运营，帮助每项业务蓬勃发展。

paragraphs.text: Our early investments in AI started out as moonshots but are now incorporated into our core products and central to future developments. In Other Bets, our fully autonomous driving technology company, Waymo, is now providing fully autonomous, paid ride-hailing services to customers in multiple cities. Isomorphic Labs is reimagining the drug discovery process from first principles, applying AI to accelerate the development of new medicines. We continue to look toward the future and to invest for the long term, most notably for the application of AI to our products and services, as well as other frontier technologies such as quantum computing.
paragraphs.translation_zh: 我们早期对 AI 的投资始于登月项目，如今已融入核心产品，并成为未来发展的中心。在 Other Bets 中，我们的全自动驾驶技术公司 Waymo 正在多个城市向客户提供全自动付费网约车服务。Isomorphic Labs 正从第一性原理重新构想药物发现流程，利用 AI 加速新药研发。我们继续着眼未来并进行长期投资，重点包括将 AI 应用于产品和服务，以及量子计算等其他前沿技术。

paragraphs.text: For reporting purposes Google comprises two segments: Google Services and Google Cloud.
paragraphs.translation_zh: 就报告目的而言，Google 由 Google Services 和 Google Cloud 两个分部组成。

paragraphs.text: We have always been committed to building helpful products that can improve the lives of millions of people worldwide. Our product innovations are what make our services widely used, and our brand one of the most recognized in the world. Google Services' core products and platforms include ads, Android, Chrome, devices, Gmail, Google Drive, Google Gemini, Google Maps, Google Photos, Google Play, Search, and YouTube, with broad and growing adoption by users around the world.
paragraphs.translation_zh: 我们始终致力于打造有帮助的产品，改善全球数百万人的生活。产品创新使我们的服务得到广泛使用，也使我们的品牌成为全球最知名的品牌之一。Google Services 的核心产品和平台包括 ads、Android、Chrome、devices、Gmail、Google Drive、Google Gemini、Google Maps、Google Photos、Google Play、Search 和 YouTube，这些产品在全球用户中的采用范围广泛且持续扩大。

paragraphs.text: Google Services generates revenues primarily by delivering both performance and brand advertising that appears on Google Search & other properties, YouTube, and Google Network partners' properties ("Google Network properties"). We continue to invest in both performance and brand advertising and seek to improve the measurability of advertising so advertisers understand the effectiveness of their campaigns.
paragraphs.translation_zh: Google Services 的收入主要来自效果广告和品牌广告，这些广告展示在 Google Search 及其他媒体、YouTube，以及 Google Network 合作伙伴的媒体（“Google Network properties”）上。我们继续投资效果广告和品牌广告，并努力提高广告效果的可衡量性，使广告主能够了解其广告活动的有效性。

paragraphs.text: In addition, Google Services generates revenues from products and services beyond advertising, including:
paragraphs.translation_zh: 此外，Google Services 还从广告以外的产品和服务中获得收入，包括：

paragraphs.text: • consumer subscriptions, which primarily include revenues from YouTube services, such as YouTube TV, YouTube Music and Premium, and NFL Sunday Ticket, as well as Google One, which offers access to our most capable Gemini models;
paragraphs.translation_zh: • 消费者订阅，主要包括来自 YouTube TV、YouTube Music and Premium 和 NFL Sunday Ticket 等 YouTube 服务的收入，以及 Google One 的收入；Google One 可提供对我们能力最强的 Gemini 模型的访问；

paragraphs.text: • platforms, which primarily include revenues from Google Play sales of apps and in-app purchases; and
paragraphs.translation_zh: • 平台，主要包括 Google Play 的应用销售和应用内购买收入；以及

paragraphs.text: • devices, which primarily include sales of the Pixel family of devices.
paragraphs.translation_zh: • 设备，主要包括 Pixel 系列设备的销售。

paragraphs.text: Through our Google Cloud Platform and Google Workspace offerings, Google Cloud generates revenues primarily from consumption-based fees and subscriptions for infrastructure, platform, applications, and other cloud services. Customers use Google Cloud in multiple ways such as:
paragraphs.translation_zh: Google Cloud 通过 Google Cloud Platform 和 Google Workspace 产品，主要从基础设施、平台、应用及其他云服务的按使用量收费和订阅收费中获得收入。客户以多种方式使用 Google Cloud，例如：

paragraphs.text: Across Alphabet, we are also using technology to try to solve big problems that affect a wide variety of industries, including transportation and health technology. Alphabet’s investment in the portfolio of Other Bets includes businesses that are at various stages of development, ranging from those in the research and development phase, such as X, our moonshot factory focused on developing breakthrough technologies, to those that are scaling commercialization, such as Waymo, which is expanding to more cities domestically, entering international markets, and further scaling operations.
paragraphs.translation_zh: 在 Alphabet 各项业务中，我们也在利用技术尝试解决影响众多行业的重大问题，包括交通和健康科技。Alphabet 对 Other Bets 组合的投资涵盖处于不同发展阶段的业务，从仍在研发阶段的 X——我们专注于开发突破性技术的登月工厂——到正在扩大商业化的 Waymo；Waymo 正扩展至更多美国城市、进入国际市场并进一步扩大运营。

paragraphs.text: Other Bets operate as independent companies and some of them have their own boards with independent members and outside investors. While these early-stage businesses naturally come with considerable uncertainty, some of them are already generating revenue and making important strides in their industries. Revenues from Other Bets are generated primarily from the sale of autonomous transportation and internet services.
paragraphs.translation_zh: Other Bets 以独立公司的形式运营，其中一些公司拥有由独立成员和外部投资者参与的董事会。尽管这些早期业务自然具有相当大的不确定性，但其中一些已开始产生收入，并在各自行业取得重要进展。Other Bets 的收入主要来自自动驾驶运输服务和互联网服务的销售。

paragraphs.translation_zh: 截至 12 月 31 日止年度，2024 2025：Google Search & other $ 198,084 $ 224,532；YouTube ads 36,147 40,367；Google Network 30,359 29,792；Google advertising 264,590 294,691；Google subscriptions, platforms, and devices 40,340 48,030；Google Services 合计 304,930 342,721；Google Cloud 43,229 58,705；Other Bets 1,648 1,537；套期保值收益（损失）211 (127)；总营收 $ 350,018 $ 402,836。

paragraphs.text: Year Ended December 31, 2024 2025 Operating income (loss): Google Services $ 121,263 $ 139,404 Google Cloud 6,112 13,910 Other Bets (4,444) (7,515) Alphabet-level activities (1) (10,541) (16,760) Total income from operations $ 112,390 $ 129,039
Google advertising revenues consist of revenues from:
paragraphs.translation_zh: Google advertising 收入包括来自以下项目的收入：

paragraphs.text: • Google Search and other properties, including revenues from traffic generated by search distribution partners who use Google.com as their default search in browsers, toolbars, etc. and other Google owned and operated properties like Gmail, Google Maps, and Google Play;
paragraphs.translation_zh: • Google Search 及其他媒体，包括将 Google.com 设为浏览器、工具栏等默认搜索服务的搜索分发合作伙伴所产生流量带来的收入，以及 Gmail、Google Maps 和 Google Play 等由 Google 拥有和运营的其他媒体收入；

paragraphs.text: • YouTube properties; and
paragraphs.translation_zh: • YouTube 媒体；以及

paragraphs.text: • Google Network properties, including revenues from Google Network properties participating in AdMob, AdSense, and Google Ad Manager.
paragraphs.translation_zh: • Google Network 媒体，包括参与 AdMob、AdSense 和 Google Ad Manager 的 Google Network 媒体所产生的收入。

paragraphs.text: • Google Cloud Platform primarily generates consumption-based fees and subscriptions for infrastructure, platform, and other services. These services provide access to solutions such as AI offerings including our enterprise AI infrastructure, Vertex AI platform, and Gemini Enterprise; cybersecurity offerings; and data and analytics solutions;
paragraphs.translation_zh: • Google Cloud Platform 主要通过基础设施、平台及其他服务的按使用量收费和订阅收费获得收入。这些服务提供对多种解决方案的访问，包括我们的企业 AI 基础设施、Vertex AI 平台和 Gemini Enterprise 等 AI 产品；网络安全产品；以及数据与分析解决方案；

paragraphs.text: • Google Workspace includes subscriptions for cloud-based communication and collaboration tools for enterprises, such as Gmail, Docs, Calendar, Drive, and Meet, with integrated features like Gemini for Google Workspace; and
paragraphs.translation_zh: • Google Workspace 包括面向企业的云通信与协作工具订阅，例如 Gmail、Docs、Calendar、Drive 和 Meet，并集成 Gemini for Google Workspace 等功能；以及

paragraphs.text: • other enterprise services.
paragraphs.translation_zh: • 其他企业服务。
